_comment: Cryptarithm locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the assignment token `[A 5]`, single letters, or digits.

_slots.{letter}: A puzzle letter, e.g. S or E
_slots.{used_letter}: The letter that already claimed a digit
_slots.{assigned}: How many letters are mapped so far
_slots.{pct}: Progress as a percentage string, e.g. 50%

player_prompt.intro:
Ampio ny taratra tsy mitovy rehetra ho taratasy mba hahitana ny aritmetika.
Ampio amin'ny alalan'ny `[A 5]`, na ovay aza.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsy mahitsy ny formatin'ny hetsika. Ampiasao ny `[A 5]`.
invalid_move.letter_not_in_puzzle: Ny litera {letter} tsy ao anaty piozila.
invalid_move.leading_zero: Tsy afaka ny ho 0 ny isa voalohany amin'ny teny iray.

outcome.incorrect: Vita ny sarintany fa tsy marina ny fampitoviana.
